text:
sam: dropped a new staging card for route-level token economics. shows gross tokens, cache hits, and a computed "shared-prefetch_credit" column. preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/dash/route-econ

leo: nice. is the shared-prefetch credit real-time? curious about staleness for bursts.

sam: it's near-real-time for direct KV hits. shared-prefetch_credit is computed by a 5m microbatch that imputes credit across routes touching the same keyset.

meera: we need to be explicit about uncertainty. sometimes the amortized number can swing negative when eviction and prefetch race. add a confidence tag.

sam: plan is to show confidence as low/medium/high based on sample rate + overlap cardinality. the UI will default to raw_kv_hits and allow toggling amortized credit.

infra-bot: deploy 6589001112-route-econ -> staging: success (14s)

leo: what's the sampling config? finance will ask for provenance when reconciling invoices.

sam: default sampling = 0.5% for full trace capture, plus aggregated counters for all requests. API will include a `provenance` string per row: "sampled|aggregate|amortized_job" and `sample_rate` numeric.

meera: where does model mapping occur? should cost be attributed to the deployed SKU or the logical model name that customers see?

sam: backend currently joins to model_catalog and emits both `sku` and `model_name`. billing uses SKU; product dashboards will show model_name by default but can pivot.

leo: UI detail: add a small sparkline for token-per-invocation variance and a hover tooltip that shows last 1h p50/p95. helps spot noisy routes.

sam: added.

meera: performance concern: amortization in the microbatch joins large windows of route->key usage. can we cap to top-N tenants per key to keep compute bounded?

sam: yes; microbatch caps at top 100 route owners per key and assigns remainder to an implicit "others" bucket. documentation will call out the cap.

tess: rollout guardrails: hide amortized column behind flag `route_econ_amortized_v1`. start with internal-only, then limited beta to finance/product.

sam: agreed. also adding an "export CSV" that includes provenance per row for offline audits.

leo: quick ask: make the API schema versioned. small change later (e.g., switching amortization algorithm) should increment version and not break reconciliations.

sam: will add `schema_version` and change-log notes in the endpoint.

meera: final: schedule 30m review with finance and observability tomorrow to validate sample weighting and to sign off on the negative-credit guidance. I'll book.

sam: thanks — I'll add a short runbook explaining negative credits (eviction overlap) and how to interpret the confidence scores. :thumbsup:
